message.content: {"recommended_method":"social_choice","consensus_potential":0.68,"fairness_assessment":"Fairly compares the three budget priorities and prevents the debate winner from determining the outcome alone; fairness improves if members can rank options and assess equipment needs and expected impact.","conflict_severity":"medium","stakeholder_analysis":[{"agent":"Agent A","position":"Prioritizes an inter-city tournament with catering and prizes to increase visibility and recruit members.","influence":0.62},{"agent":"Agent B","position":"Prioritizes allocating the full budget to replacing or supplementing worn educational equipment.","influence":0.78},{"agent":"Agent C","position":"Supports an equal split between a smaller tournament and educational equipment as a balanced compromise.","influence":0.7},{"agent":"Agent 4","position":"Challenges the framing of the options and calls for evidence-based assessment of needs, costs, and expected results.","influence":0.65}],"recommended_resolution":"compromise","governance_reasoning":"Use a ranked or approval-based social-choice vote after a short fact-finding phase on equipment condition, tournament costs, and measurable outcomes. A compromise is most likely to preserve legitimacy, while allowing the final allocation to depart from an arbitrary 50/50 split if evidence shows one need is substantially greater."}
